feeds.title: Village Missions Blog
feeds.description: Village Missionaries partner with members of their churches for God's kingdom and His glory as they serve God together. Follow the Village Missions Blog to get news and updates on their mission to work with rural churches in North America and find out how you can be involved.

feeds.title: Village Church Hamilton Blog
feeds.description: Village Church Hamilton Blog shares information about the activities in the church, events held, bible teachings, and otehr related articles. Located in Texas, US, Village Church is a community-focused church that aims to help people connect with God and each other through regular prayers, Bible study, and community programs.

feeds.title: Village Church Rva Blog
feeds.description: Their mission is to worship God by helping as many people as possible become fully devoted followers of Jesus. Tehy have church blog sharing Information about their community events, prayers, teachings and more.

feeds.title: Red Village Church Blog
feeds.description: Red Village Church Blog includes information about church activities, articles, sermons, interviews, and other audio content from their video blog. At RVC, it is their hope to do all things in light of the love God has for us through the Gospel. Their primary response to the Gospel is to be worship. they desire as a church to do everything out of a heart of worship.

feeds.title: Evangelical Free Church Blog
feeds.description: Village Church began in 1975 when 12 families attending Family Camp at Camp Shamineau expressed an interest in meeting for Bible study and worship in the Loretto area. The purpose of this church shall be to glorify God in every way prescribed or approved by the Holy Scriptures under the guidance of the Holy Spirit. Follow their blog to learn more about the church, its beliefs, community gathering, mission, and values,

feeds.title: The Village Christian Church Blog
feeds.description: Check the Village Christian Church Blog regularly and find Bible-written inspiration to live a better life. The Village is a non-denominational church that teaches the Bible and equips people to live it out. Their mission is to help people experience Life Change, Life Growth, and Life Purpose.

feeds.title: Cummington Village Church Blog
feeds.description: The Village Church is an interfaith congregation providing services on the first Sunday of each month. Church provides formal and informal programs, music events and space for meetings, classes and other community use. The blog is about community events, activities, camps for children, the latest news and updates.

feeds.title: The Village Church Columbus Blog
feeds.description: The Village Church Columbus Blog shares Writings and resources from and for The Village Community Church and other useful related stuff. The Village Church began with a heart and vision for the city of Columbus.

feeds.title: Urban Village Church
feeds.description: We are a bold church rooted in the gospel of Jesus Christ, which tears down walls that divide us and build up life. Our mission is to create Jesus-loving, inclusive communities that ignite the city. Learn more about our church, community gathering, teaching, preachings, events and more.
